claim: Screens that time themselves with CPU delay loops (title, attract, name entry) run far too fast at 28 MHz; speed up only during play and check every non-play screen for software timing.

evidence.text: 28 MHz only from level draw to the next Layer 2 off; title, scores, name entry and continue stay at 3.5 MHz. At 28 MHz every update took 3 frames (45% fast; recording averages 4.35, title alternates 2 and 3). Title-to-scores 621 frames vs 597 original.
